rule: E1: dates fixed before building; settings chosen on validation only; written before the first test run

periods.rule: E1: fixed by date before building. Labels look 30 days ahead, so each period's last labelled day is 30 days before its cut-off, and no training row's label window ends after its cut-off.

train.first_scored_day: each pump's first complete row, after its warm-up

periods.scored_days: pump-days scored for average precision; a period's step reads no row after its cut-off
periods.alert_window_days: alerts can open on any day of the alert window, the last 30 days included

no_complete_label_window.use: no part in training, thresholds or average precision; scored for the forward risk list risk_2025-12-31.csv, labelled 'no complete label window'

periods.no_refit: The model trained to 1 December 2024 is the one tested. Refitting on validation rows would need a new threshold (M3), with nothing left to choose it on.
periods.seasons: Validation is winter and spring, test is summer and autumn. A threshold that travels badly shows in the test result, and it is reported as it falls.
periods.test_scored: once per frozen configuration; eval/ml/split_lock.json holds the dates and the hash of the chosen settings, committed before the first test run, and the test step refuses to run without it (E1)
periods.dates_read_from: this file; code never types a date, and tests stop at the end of validation and take the test end from this file

missed_controls_accepted.decision: Reece, 12 November 2026, question box: record the shuffled-label miss (1.291 times the dummy against 1.25; one shuffle of five at 2.24) and score the test period once with these settings. Diagnosis: evidence/diagnosis-shuffled-labels-2026-11-12.txt.
